headline: De la Espriella Confirms Colombia Has Reactivated Negotiations on the Economic Partnership Agreement with Japan
summary: President De la Espriella confirmed that Colombia has reactivated negotiations on an Economic Partnership Agreement with Japan. He said it would open new markets for industrial and agricultural products.
why: Economic Partnership Agreements reduce tariffs and open export markets, which matters for trade flows between Latin America and Asia.
